title: Package-local documentation adapter APIs
scope: Load verified release prose and attach it to declared CLI/OpenAPI structures.
proposed_work_bound: O(document bytes + interface nodes + actual annotations/emitted text) plus required ordering; no repeated whole-document traversal per small annotation.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(materialized metadata/output) as explicit API contract, independent of archive corpus.
semantic_requirement: Resource digest, exact declared destination ownership and native API/CLI behavior retained.
proposed_witness: Many commands/routes and repeated annotations; source identity mismatch, unknown destination and exact rendering output; count structural visits.

title: Runtime initialization and installation control
scope: Validate installation/runtime configuration, load native providers and recover eligible operational work.
proposed_work_bound: O(config/schema/provider metadata + actual active recovery records); current startup does not scan/rewrite all archive payload. Pre-v1 current-schema initialization is G08; explicit rebuild/reconciliation scans use G20/G26, not an old-version migration path.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded initialization windows; no growing active transaction while waiting for external resources. Explicit full state reconciliation allowed as its own bounded lifecycle.
semantic_requirement: Exact environment/config/linkage, state ownership and no implicit upgrades; installation failure not partial success.
proposed_witness: Identical schema/config with growing archived corpus but fixed active jobs; startup after interrupted work and missing provider/config.

title: Release artifacts, source discovery and Contract Render
scope: Repository development/release generation, packaging and source-closure/HTML construction.
proposed_work_bound: INTERNAL budget: O(source/dependency/contract bytes + declared references + output bytes), plus explicit sorts/indexes and delegated compiler/build costs. No public bound for a whole CI/build run; generation must not repeatedly expand cross-links or interface descendants.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Working state bounded or output-sized as appropriate; build tool resource behavior separately measured.
semantic_requirement: Do not freeze SQL layout, generator traversal or build seconds as an archive contract. Shipped library APIs are G61; released artifact verification uses its actual public consumer's bounds.
proposed_witness: Scale synthetic contract node/ref counts, release-file counts and rendered output; distinguish generated declaration from executed evidence.
tooling_owner: repository release/contract/qualification machinery (not a runtime product owner)

title: Qualification, timing and growth-evidence machinery
scope: Developer/CI test orchestration, measurement and evidence collation.
proposed_work_bound: INTERNAL budget: O(test/report/counter-event bytes + workload discovery) plus ordering. Instrumentation O(observed work) with bounded per-event overhead; no separate rerun solely to collect timing or source-sized decode per progress event.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded logs/counter memory and explicit retained artifacts; peak resource measurement covers children/containers where applicable.
semantic_requirement: Functional result, growth conformance and wall time remain separate; missing required evidence fails. A fast mock or family reference does not certify a public growth claim.
proposed_witness: Inject absent/stale/partial/cancelled evidence and valid slow runs; verify expected work coverage from owners; measure instrumentation overhead and aggregate wall time.
tooling_owner: repository release/contract/qualification machinery (not a runtime product owner)
